description: Source code for automation utility functions including parsing, disassembly, assembly, and file operations related to automation files in JSON and XML formats.

methods.name: getZilkerBasePath
methods.description: Returns the absolute path to the base zilker repository, based on environment variable.

methods.name: getBaseUtilityPath
methods.description: Returns the absolute path to the automation utility tool directory.

methods.name: getOutPath
methods.description: Returns the absolute path to the automation utility output directory.

methods.name: createAutomation
methods.description: Allocates and initializes a new automation struct.

methods.name: destroyAutomation
methods.description: Frees memory associated with an automation struct and its components.

methods.name: parseFileToAutomation
methods.description: Parses a JSON or XML string into an automation struct based on current data format.

methods.name: writeAutomationToFile
methods.description: Serializes an automation struct and writes it to a specified file.

methods.name: disassembleAndWriteAutomation
methods.description: Disassembles an automation into multiple files and directories.

methods.name: assembleAndWriteAutomation
methods.description: Assembles a disassembled automation from files and writes it to a file.
